blocks.text: ILIGAN CITY — A total road closure will be implemented along a section of the Mariano Lluch Badelles Sr. Road in Barangay Tambacan, Iligan City, starting Thursday, October 1, to pave the way for the rehabilitation of the Tambacan Bridge. Pursuant to Sangguniang Panlungsod Resolution No. 26-670, vehicles are not allowed on the affected road section until the rehabilitation is completed. READ: Flood control fiasco cuts funding for Iligan rivers The rehabilitation will include replacing the bridge slab and retrofitting its structural components to address the bridge’s deteriorating condition and improve its safety and structural stability.
